title: IngredientItem
description: One food in a meal, as returned by POST /meal/photo and POST /meal/text. Macros for the item are computed with contracts/ts/macros.ts: per_100g × grams / 100.

name.description: Food name as detected by the model, e.g. "scrambled eggs". Shown to the user.

food_id.description: The matched food entry. Always the same as candidates[0].food_id.

grams.description: Estimated portion in grams. The user can edit it.

confidence.description: How sure the AI is about this item (detection and portion), 0 to 1.

per_100g.description: Macros of the matched food per 100 g. Always the same as candidates[0].per_100g.

candidates.description: Up to 3 food entries that match the name, best first. candidates[0] is the one used above; the user can switch to another, which replaces food_id and per_100g.

foodId.description: Food entry id, prefixed by source: fdc (FoodData Central), off (Open Food Facts), label (read from a nutrition label), manual (entered by the user).

name.description: Name of the food entry in its source database, e.g. "Egg, whole, cooked, scrambled".
